It operates under the Government of India and has been designated as an "Institution of National Importance" by an Act of Parliament. JIPMER Puducherry scholarships
are offered to the students having good merit score and low family income.
Interested students can apply for the particular scholarships by filling out the
JIPMER Puducherry scholarship form

J

JIPMER Admission Process for M.Sc/PGD Courses
Candidates, after meeting the JIPMER eligibility criteria for PG courses, should fill out the registration form.
After paying the application form fee, candidates must take the entrance test at the selected test centre.
After qualifying for the entrance test, a merit list will be prepared based on the entrance test scores.
Candidates should apply for counselling and select the desired course and specialisation.
After the seat allotment, candidates should get their documents verified and pay the fee to confirm JIPMER admission.
JIPMER Admission Process for MS/MDS/MD Courses
Candidates are required to register for the Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test (INI CET).
After paying the application fee of Rs 4,000 (Rs 3,200 for SC/ST/EWS), candidates should take the INI CET and secure a valid score.
Qualified candidates must participate in the seat allocation process.
Candidates will be shortlisted for JIPMER admission based on the scores obtained in the entrance examination.
To confirm admission, candidates should get their documents verified and pay the JIPMER fee.

JIPMER PhD Admissions 2026
Candidates can apply for JIPMER Puducherry PhD admissions in full-time mode. JIPMER PhD courses are offered in specialisations like Biochemistry, Preventive and Social Medicine, and Medical Oncology.
JIPMER PhD Admission Process 2026
Candidates should fill out the JIPMER PhD application form available on the official website.
The selection for the PhD course is based on the written test and viva-voice examination. Candidates who score more than 50% on the entrance test will qualify for the viva-voice examination.
A merit list is generated for the qualified candidates, and they must get their documents verified.
JIPMER admission is confirmed only after the successful completion of document verification and fee payment.
JIPMER Admissions 2026 for DM/M.Ch
JIPMER Puducherry DM admissions are offered for courses in three specialisations. The DM courses at JIPMER Puducherry include DM Neurology, DM Neuroimaging and Intervention and DM Neuroanaesthesia. JIPMER Puducherry M.Ch admissions are offered in two specialisations. JIPMER M.Ch admissions are offered for M.Ch Neurosurgery and M.Ch Neurosurgery.
JIPMER Puducherry Admission Process for DM/M.Ch
Candidates are required to register and appear for the
INI SS
entrance exam.
After paying the application fee, candidates should take the INI SS and secure a valid score.
Candidates having valid scores in entrance exams are required to attend the JIPMER counselling process.
Qualified candidates must participate in the seat allocation process. To confirm JIPMER PG Admission, candidates should get their documents verified and pay the fee.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's)
1
:
What research opportunities does JIPMER offer?
JIPMER offers numerous research opportunities to its students through different programmes at various levels. JIPMER Puducherry offers research opportunities are offered through courses like MS, MD, M.Ch, and PhD courses. The institute also offers advanced courses in research methodology.
2
:
Who are the faculty members at JIPMER Puducherry?
JIPMER Puducherry has well-qualified and well-experienced faculty members. Some of the faculty members at JIPMER Puducherry include Dr. Balasubramanian Madhan, Dr Krishnan Balasubramanian, Dr. Guru Prasad.T, Dr. Nivethitha Bhaskar, Dr. Saravanan Rajendiran and others.
3
:
Is JIPMER autonomous or not?
Yes, JIPMER became an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India in 2008. It is one of the leading medical institutes in India.
4
:
What is JIPMER famous for?
JIPMER is located in Puducherry and received 4th position as per NIRF 2025 rankings. The college is known for its healthcare services and academic services. The institute offers UG, PG, and doctoral programmes for students with top-notch facilities.
5
:
Does JIPMER come under NEET?
Admission to the MBBS course at JIPMER  Puducherry and Karaikal campus is based on the scores of National Eligibility cum Entrance Examination (NEET) scores conducted by NTA. Candidates having valid scores in the entrance exam are required to attend the counselling session conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC).
6
:
What are the courses offered by JIPMER?
The courses at JIPMER include MBBS, MD, MS, DM, M.Ch, B.Sc, M.Sc, B.ASLP, MPH, PhD, and PGD courses in full time mode. All the courses are offered in various branches of Medical and Allied Sciences.
7
:
How can I take admission to JIPMER B.Sc programme?
For JIPMER B.Sc admission one has to appear for the common entrance exam conducted by the institute and secure at least 50 percentile and further participate in the counselling process.
8
:
How can I take admission to the MS programme offered by JIPMER?
As per the JIPMER admission process, one has to qualify INI CET conducted by AIIMS Delhi and further participate in its counselling process. Candidates are required to meet the cutoff score released in the form of opening and closing ranks.
9
:
What is the course duration of JIPMER M.Ch programme?
The course duration of JIPMER M.Ch programme is three years. The M.Ch course is offered in nine different specialisations.
10
:
Is JIPMER recognised by the MCI?
Yes,
Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research Puducherry
has been recognised by the Medical Council of India. The institute is approved by NMC and INC as well.
